allow: PowerShell($pages = '/', '/login', '/register'; foreach \($p in $pages\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Output "$p -> $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { Write-Output "$p -> ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } }; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/settings/members" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30 -MaximumRedirection 0 } catch { Write-Output "/settings/members \(guest\) -> $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\) redirect to login \(expected\)" })
